purpose: Array first-class captures freeze an inherited instance factory despite later referenced receiver/method writes; the original array, both closures and maker retire before the private-static Generator runs, while its equivalent sibling stays fresh.
source:
<?php
class Mid81A {
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Mid81A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf81A'), '|';
        try {
            yield 81;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
    public function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return self::body();
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf81A extends Mid81A {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield 0; }
}
$maker = new Leaf81A();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$receiver = $maker;
$method = 'make';
$callback = [&$receiver, &$method];
$first = $callback(...);
$second = $callback(...);
$receiver = null;
$method = 'body';
unset($callback, $receiver, $method);
$weakFirst = WeakReference::create($first);
$weakSecond = WeakReference::create($second);
$g = $first();
$other = $second();
unset($first, $second, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFirst->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakSecond->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 81), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($other instanceof Generator), '|';
unset($other, $weakMaker, $weakFirst, $weakSecond);
echo 'E';

purpose: A first-class array capture freezes the inherited factory when the source array method changes, then the callable retires while the saved protected Generator frame keeps the actual receiver through close.

<?php
class Base81B {
    protected function body() {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        try {
            yield 81;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        }
    }
}
class Mid81B extends Base81B {
    public function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return parent::body();
    }
}
class Leaf81B extends Mid81B {
    public function body() { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
$maker = new Leaf81B();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$callback = [$maker, 'make'];
$factory = $callback(...);
$callback[1] = 'body';
unset($callback);
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactory->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf81B), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 81), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakFactory, $weakMaker);
echo 'E';

purpose: A first-class class-method string freezes its Leaf called scope before the original string variable selects Mid; the retired callable still authorizes the Leaf protected override and stored return.

<?php
class Mid81C {
    public static function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return static::body();
    }
    protected static function body() { echo 'BAD-MID|'; yield 0; }
}
class Leaf81C extends Mid81C {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Leaf81C'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf81C'), '|';
        yield 81;
        return 82;
    }
}
$name = 'Leaf81C::make';
$factory = $name(...);
$name = 'Mid81C::make';
unset($name);
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactory->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 81), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 82), '|';
unset($g, $weakFactory);
echo 'E';

purpose: A first-class array captures private inherited make before its original array changes; retired callable/host preserve lexical Base and called Host authority for a static byref Generator. Primed SEND parks after received-CV unset, preserving only its API argument and reference cache through supplied Fiber abort.
source:
<?php
class Token81 {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input81 {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
class Base81 {
    public function capture() {
        $row = [$this, 'make'];
        $factory = $row(...);
        $row[0] = null;
        $row[1] = 'absent';
        echo 'CAPTURE|', $row[0] === null, '|', $row[1] === 'absent', '|';
        return $factory;
    }
    private function make(&$token) {
        global $weakHost;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Base81', '|', static::class === 'Host81', '|',
             $this === $weakHost->get(), '|';
        return self::body($token);
    }
    private static function &body(&$token) {
        global $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base81', '|', static::class === 'Host81', '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('paused81');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token81, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input81, '|';
        }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'HOST|'; }
}
class Host81 extends Base81 {
    public function make(&$token) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; return []; }
}
function Run81() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input81());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$token = new Token81();
$alias =& $token;
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$host = new Host81();
$weakHost = WeakReference::create($host);
$factory = $host->capture();
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory($token);
unset($factory, $host, $token);
$token = 81;
echo 'FRESH|', $weakFactory->get() === null, '|', $weakHost->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token81, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run81');
$stop = new Exception('stop81');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
unset($alias);
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'paused81', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $token === 81, '|', $weakInput->get() instanceof Input81, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakToken->get() instanceof Token81, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token81, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
